{{Top|leg}}
A '''Comm Analysis Amplifier/Receptor''' was part of the communications equipment installed on [[Uulshos Manufacturing/Legends|Uulshos Manufacturing's]] [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|LAVr QH-7 Chariot]]. The amplief/receptor, along with other communications equipment such as a [[Subspace Scrambler/Transceiver]], [[Long-Range Comm Transceiver]], and a [[Low-Frequency Encryptor]], allowed the Chariot [[Commander/Legends|commander]] to coordinate combat units in the field with up to date detailed intelligence.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
